summary.headline: Annual Astrology and Planetary Judgments
summary.text: Catalog entries 34–46 on annual astrology, covering year ascendants, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, lunar nodes, zodiacal signs, planetary configurations, rumors, seasonal turnings, afflicted stars, house-rulers, triplicities, exaltation, Saracen abundance, and the duration of judgments from ascending signs. Authorities and sources include Gechias, Ioannes son of Apiskoun, the Persians, and the great syntaxis.
